headline: Loaded carts finally have bodies
lede: FloorBoss's knee law shipped: a loaded cart turning a corner sweeps the outer diagonal, routing refuses swings that clip a rack, and racking a throat shut now dies with a named NO KNEE refusal. Two mutants killed, 14/14 contract, live on prod.

notes.text: Walls are not knees — only a rack in the swept diagonal legislates traffic; a wall there is a legal dead-end spur (#2546 doctrine).
Backpedals are free: a no-reverse knee variant passed every rig but collapsed the career economy (seed 99 banked 2 vs 4–6). Measure careers before tightening kinematics.
New MUT_ flags must join the plant-guard list or the mutant run silently falls through green — mutateguard's dirty-tree refusal caught it.
